content.summary: סמסונג MX-ST40F הוא רמקול מסיבות נייד מסדרת Sound Tower עם סוללה מובנית. מתאים למי שמחפש רמקול למסיבות בבית ובחצר, עם כניסות למיקרופון ולגיטרה.
highlights: עד 12 שעות ניגון מהסוללה (עם תאורה כבויה)
goodFor: מסיבות בבית או בחצר בלי תלות בשקע חשמל
קריוקי ונגינה עם מיקרופון או גיטרה
השמעה מהטלפון דרך Bluetooth או מקובץ ב-USB
considerations: זמן הסוללה המוצהר נמדד עם תאורה כבויה, ועם תאורה דולקת הוא עשוי להיות קצר יותר

reviewFlags.issue: All pages found are for the US variant MX-ST40F/ZA. No Israeli Samsung product page or Israeli importer listing was found, so the Israeli variant, plug and voltage are unconfirmed.

The 160 W figure appears only in one US retailer page title. Samsung and Abt pages do not state it, so the fact may not be publishable on its own. The 80 W battery-mode figure is not on any fetched page.
Sources conflict. The Abt listing and its footnote say IPX4. A Samsung US AI-generated review summary says IPX5. The IPX5 mention is not a manufacturer specification, so IPX4 is used.
No fetched page gave the weight, so the catalog value of about 12.7 kg is unverified. Do not publish a weight without a source.
Dimensions are published only in inches (24.41 in tall). The catalog's about 62 cm was not verified in centimetres. Height in cm should be checked against a metric source before publishing.
The catalog names the bass mode Punchy. The Abt listing says Punch. The corrected value follows the page.
All sources describe the US variant MX-ST40F/ZA; Israeli variant, plug and voltage unconfirmed.
160 W appears only in one US retailer page title; the catalog's 80 W battery-mode figure is unsourced.
Catalog says safe for use by the pool; Abt says IPX4 splash resistance and not advised for beach or pool use.
Catalog weight of about 12.7 kg is not on any fetched page.
Catalog name says 62 cm; sources give height only in inches (24.41 in). Check against a metric source.
Only Punch mode is confirmed by a quote; catalog lists Punchy, Deep, Gentle.
